# Amar Kushtia (আমার কুষ্টিয়া)
> Smart digital civic service network, marketplace, tourism, housing, emergency directory, and community portal for Kushtia district, Bangladesh.

## Core Features
- Tourism & Heritage: Detailed guide to Lalon Shah Shrine, Shilaidaha Rabindra Kuthibari, Hardinge Bridge, Kangal Harinath Museum, and Gorai River.
- Emergency Directory: Immediate access to Kushtia Sadar Police, Fire Service, General Hospital, Blood Donors, and Ambulance services.
- House Rent & Marketplace: Verified property rentals, buy/sell listings, and local classifieds in Kushtia.
- Civic Services & Directory: Technicians, Electricians, Lawyers, Doctors, and Skilled Service Providers across all 6 upazilas.
- Secret Crime Reporter: 100% encrypted, anonymous crime reporting directly connecting with official authorities.
- Bus & Train Schedules: Real-time schedule information for Poradah Junction, Kushtia Court Station, and Mojompur Bus Terminals.
- Community News & Events: Verified local notices, blood donation requests, and event updates.

## Technical Specifications
- Platform: Progressive Web Application (PWA) with offline capabilities.
- Accessibility: 100% WCAG compliant with Bengali typography and native mobile optimization.
- Security: End-to-end client-side encryption for anonymous reports and Firebase Authentication.
